title: Measure Gate A on chg-loop tickets apart from human intake, and pin Gate B's self-modification floor (#986 items 2 and 4)

story.i_want_to: see Gate A's escalation rate on the machine-written chg-loop tickets separately from the human ones, and know which paths of claude-config and chg must stay behind a human
story.so_that: the claim that evidence-carrying tickets escalate far less than the human baseline is measured rather than assumed, and the loop can never merge, unreviewed, a change to the code that gates it

rationale: chg files issues labelled chg-loop on claude-config, chg and home_care_billing, each carrying a failure fingerprint, its occurrences, a root cause or 'unknown, investigate', and acceptance criteria written as checks. KB a08b94b2 expects them to escalate far less than the 69% human baseline. The Gate A replay report had only the intake and all strata, so that expectation could not be checked. The gate itself is not relaxed: only the report gains the split. For Gate B, a repository absent from DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG already escalates every change with {:unknown_repo, repo}; claude-config and chg are absent today, which satisfies #986, but nothing said what their entries must contain once they get one.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.DeliveryGates.Measurement.Ticket carries chg_loop?, true exactly when the ticket's labels include chg-loop; the title plays no part.
The Gate A report carries two new strata, chg_loop (the chg-loop tickets) and human (every other ticket), in the main strata, in the sensitivity run and in the printed summary. They partition all.
The intake and all strata keep their definitions and values, so artifacts from before and after the change compare on them.

The committed gate_a_2026-09-14 artifact is not rewritten (docs/measurements/README.md: a new dated pair per run). A new pair, gate_a_2026-10-19, is generated by mix loopctl.gates.measure_a from a fresh gh issue list of mkreyman/home_care_billing and carries the four strata; mix loopctl.gates.check_measurements passes over the directory.

docs/agent-delivery-loop.md states that a repository absent from DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG escalates every change, that claude-config and chg are absent, and states the human_paths floor each must carry once it gets an entry: chg's gate, verified/master, culprit/revert and CI code; claude-config's deny lists and hook wiring, its blocking and granting hooks, its gating plugins, its git hooks and CI. The pasteable globs live in KB article 4a86157b, not in the public doc, because both repositories are private.
A Gate B test pins that an unconfigured repository escalates {:unknown_repo, repo} on an otherwise-clear change at merge, and on the triage screen with or without predicted touches.

test_cases.name: the chg_loop flag
steps: parse a gh issue record labelled chg-loop, one with no label or a lookalike label, and one whose TITLE says chg-loop
expected_results: only the labelled record has chg_loop? true

test_cases.name: four strata on a mixed corpus
steps: build Report.gate_a over two chg-loop tickets (one escalating), an intake [Feature], an intake [Bug], an enhancement and a not-planned issue, with and without a sensitivity run
expected_results: chg_loop is 2 tickets, 1 escalated; human is 4 tickets, 2 escalated, 1 not_story
chg_loop + human equals all on total, escalated and not_story
intake and all hold the values they held before the change, and on a corpus with no chg-loop ticket human equals all
the sensitivity run and the summary carry chg_loop and human
breaking the split (splitting on intake? instead of chg_loop?) fails four of these tests

test_cases.name: unknown repository escalation pin
steps: evaluate Gate B at merge, and run triage_screen/3, for mkreyman/claude-config and mkreyman/chg against a configuration that names neither, on a README-only change that clears for the configured repository
expected_results: triage_screen/3 returns [{:unknown_repo, repo}] with and without predicted touches

test_cases.name: committed artifacts stay consistent
expected_results: every artifact carries its pins and the directory passes

technical_notes: Strata are computed once by Report.gate_a_strata/1, used by the main report and the sensitivity run so the two cannot diverge. Escalation rows gain a chg_loop flag beside intake. The Gate B path globs were checked against git ls-files of chg at f14c483 and claude-config at 31bd0a8 with Loopctl.DeliveryGates.Glob: every one matches at least one file, so none is a stale trigger. chg's landing lives in chg-server under server/, which does not exist yet; its glob is to be added with it, never before, because a pattern that matches nothing escalates every change as a stale trigger.
